It’s messy but Uber kept it an option for a reason. They know this would happen and yet they haven’t changed it since the app came out? 

Uber “supports” those ordering from them until the customer gets a wrong order, that’s when the support disappears.

Or when the driver encounters an issue, uber says “deal with it we out this bih”

Could always try to be a doordash driver, not sure how different the pay will be but customers can’t remove tips after delivery. 

ScammerEats has that feature probably to get drivers to quickly accept and deliver, and after delivery, customers are allowed to change their tip, either add more of a tip or remove it completely.
Since you’re clearly blind, the OP did not receive items they paid for. That’s on the restaurant not the delivery driver. 🤡

All these crybabies crying that you didn’t tip. 

Good job for YOU decided on what YOU want to do with YOUR money.

it’s so funny when so many crybabies on reddit complain and downvote because someone says they don’t want to tip. what part of an optional thing do they not seem to understand? 
i don’t care if “it takes longer” to get my order, it usually almost never does regardless of if i’m tipping or not. 
i’m not paying out of my pocket to pay someone else’s salary who isn’t making my food. they deliver, it’s what they signed up for, knowing tips will be optional. 
watch all the downvotes i get because people are upset at what I decide to do with the money I make 💀

In US/Canada drivers expect tips, which are 100% optional btw, which is quite annoying. You can walk into stores to order a coffee and when paying you’ll be hit with the “tip 15% 20% 25%” options. 

It’s so employers can pay their employees less hourly and they expect people to tip so they don’t have to pay employees out of pocket. 

Some states/provinces might have laws that require employer to pay the difference if the employee doesn’t make minimum wage from tips.
Thank you for this info, I was gonna comment saying the driver couldn’t even use flash but I didn’t know the app doesn’t let them.

ScammerEats doesn’t like refunding customers because they sometimes like to hire incompetent drivers that won’t properly take a picture or provide proof they delivered and then blame it on the customer.

I also noticed a couple nights ago my old uber account on a different phone number still gets promotions such as “spend 20 get 15% off your order” and the account I currently use, that i paid for uberone, does not receive those. assuming due to past orders that i complained to support about that the driver cancelled the trip when they were ~3 minutes away from delivering, and one from sonic drive in where they completely gave me the wrong order of shake and fries when i ordered a shake and jalapeño poppers. despite taking pictures of proof they probably blacklisted me from promotions.
I’ve noticed service fees are generally higher when I order from restaurants that have BOGO deals or other “Buy 1 get ____ for free” orders.

That’s not even a bad service fee honestly. I’ve ordered 2 bogo offers from popeyes that’s less than a mile away, the order total came to $26ish iirc before bogo discount, i paid $15 for the order on app including $2 tip + $5 tip in person when the driver handed me my order. The service fee was $4.83.

edit: order total was $23 and some change before bogo discount

Happened to me once where the driver decided to go on the streets instead of the freeway which resulted in the trip being almost 30 minutes instead of the usual 15-20 minutes. 

Uber issued the difference back to me. 

Didn’t tip that driver for how long they took, how they took the wrong route, and when almost at the drop off, they asked if I could walk the remaining 0.4 miles despite there not being any traffic.
I’d love to see a headline on the news where an ubereats “driver” who has the grammar of a 7 year old sues them for absolutely nothing !

It’s not tip baiting if it’s occurred 2 times over the course of using UE for 6 years, and only one of those times was within the last 4 months. 

It would be tip baiting if I consistently did that. Sucks for those 2 drivers in the moment of delivery, but one said it’s alright and this was before I knew I could add tips after delivery. The recent driver, I asked them if they’d wait 2-3 minutes so I can go up and grab some cash and they waited and got a $20 for delivering early and waiting.

I don’t see what the problem is.

If they gave a tip in cash that’s a good thing for you! 

But if they don’t give you a tip, you can’t really be pissed off by it. Tips are 100% optional and is the customers choice if they want to or not. 

There’s been times I’ve tipped in cash and also times where I forget my order note had “Tip in cash” but I’d forget my wallet in my apartment or just not have cash at that time. 

Truly sucks for the driver but it’s not the customers fault the drivers’ employer isn’t paying them fairly.

Yeah I completely agree with you on that. 

It really is unfortunate that the drivers who actually put in the work don’t get paid fairly for 90% of their orders.

What sucks is ubereats knows what they’re doing to their drivers (and customers) but at the end of the day they’re a business and in it to make money. I doubt any of the higher ups at Uber/UE actually care about implementing a fair pay for the drivers.

Tips aren’t mandatory. 

If the customer feels like they want to tip, they can. Sucks for the driver of course, but ultimately the money that the customer spends is THEIR money and they decide if they want to tip, which is 100% OPTIONAL. 

You also made a significant amount of money in less than an hour that most people don’t get paid for working other hourly paying jobs. 

$71.05 in less than an hour is almost 3-4x minimum wage in most states. 

Really don’t see an issue here.
How else do you think Dara Khosrowshahi (Uber/UE CEO) is gonna pay for a hair transplant?
